A '''battle''' was fought in the [[Herdessa system/Legends|Herdessa system]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders won the battle.<ref name="TEA" />
